versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Suggests quick evening meals using AirnodeHub Spoonacular for users undecided after work.
- Extracts user preferences like ingredients, time, servings, diets, intolerances, dislikes, equipment, and effort.
- Uses documented external APIs to discover and detail recipes via HTTP POST—never substitutes generic or recalled suggestions.
- Recommends three practical meal options, optimized for effort, speed, and main ingredients, with concise methods and relevant sourced info.
- Includes clear fallback behavior if API POST fails or is blocked.
- Attributes all recipe facts to Spoonacular via AirnodeHub and avoids estimating unsourced details.
